# Security Policy

## Scope

This repository is a community-maintained copy of the Altair project. Please distinguish vulnerabilities in this repository's own changes from vulnerabilities in the upstream Altair project.

- For vulnerabilities introduced by changes specific to this repository, use GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** option on this repository's **Security** tab when private vulnerability reporting is available.
- For vulnerabilities affecting upstream Altair code independently of this repository's changes, follow the upstream project's current security policy: https://github.com/altair-graphql/altair/security

Do not report sensitive vulnerabilities through public issues, pull requests, discussions, or commit messages.

## Supported versions

The default branch is the maintained branch for this repository. Older branches, snapshots, and releases may not receive security fixes. Prefer testing and reporting against the latest available revision.

## What to include

A useful private report includes the affected revision, component or file, security impact, safe reproduction steps, relevant configuration, and a proposed mitigation where known. Remove credentials, tokens, private data, and unrelated personal information from reports and logs.

## If private reporting is unavailable

Contact the repository owner through the GitHub profile and request a private disclosure channel. Do not post exploit details publicly while arranging contact.

## Credential exposure

If a credential is exposed, revoke or rotate it immediately. Removing the credential from a file or commit does not invalidate it.

## Response expectations

Reports will be reviewed as time and severity permit. No fixed response-time or remediation SLA is promised. Please allow reasonable time for assessment, fixes, and coordinated disclosure.
